traditional: Comfort meets the wound about needing it; being tended touches the place that learned not to ask.

modern.blend: Care and the old ache arrive together; accepting comfort is the day's actual work.
modern.harmonious: Tending flows without triggering the old defense; help gets accepted mid-struggle.
modern.hard: The need swallowed mid-sentence; the unspoken test set for loved ones, which backfires.
modern.business: Support offered at work lands on old sensitivities; accept help without treating it as a verdict.

cyclicNote: Node entries read to the axis: contact with one node is always contact with both; never render separate NN and SN cards for one event.
